# JobNimbus

JobNimbus is a CRM and project management software designed for contractors, helping streamline scheduling, estimates, invoicing, and job tracking.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/jobnimbus/.

## Actions

- **Create File Attachment Type**: Create a new file attachment type.
- **Create Location**: Create a new location in jobnimbus.
- **Create Material Order**: Create a new material order (v2).
- **Create Task**: Create a new task.
- **Create Workflow Status**: Create a new status in an existing workflow.
- **Get Account Settings**: Retrieve account-wide settings (workflows, types, sources).
- **Get Activity by ID**: Retrieve a specific activity by its id.
- **Get Contact by ID**: Retrieve a contact by id.
- **Get File Attachment by ID**: Retrieve a specific file attachment's raw content by id.
- **Get Product by ID**: Retrieve a specific product by id (v2).
- **Get Units of Measure**: Retrieve list of supported units of measure.
- **List Activities** (read-only): Retrieve all activities.
- **List Contacts**: List all contacts.
- **List Invoices**: List all invoices (v2).
- **List Material Orders**: List all material orders (v2).
- **List Payments**: Retrieve payments list with optional filters.
- **List Products**: List all products.
- **List Tasks**: List all tasks.
- **List Work Orders**: Retrieve all work orders (v2).
- **Update Contact**: Update an existing contact.
- **Update Task**: Update an existing task.
